title: Update the specialised substitute residential care register
summary: Find out how to update information on the specialised substitute residential care (SSRC) register.
intro:
The specialised substitute residential care (SSRC) register records information about children and young people accessing overnight care services and the agencies that provide or supervise that care.

The SSRC register:

Children and young people have a right to access and correct any information held about them by a provider or on the SSRC register.
what_you_need: Send an email to ssrc@ocg.nsw.gov.au to request access to the SSRC register.

how_to_steps.text: Send an email to ssrc@ocg.nsw.gov.au to request access to the SSRC register.

contact: For details about the SSRC visit the NSW Office of the Children’s Guardian (OCG) website or contact OCG.

external_links.text: log in to the SSRC register

faqs.q: Who can update the SSRC register?
faqs.a: You must be a care provider to update the SSRC register.

faqs.q: Where can I find details about the SSRC register?
faqs.a: For details about the SSRC, visit the NSW Office of the Children’s Guardian (OCG) website or contact OCG.
